reason: Both conversations correctly lead with the safety boundary (stop resetting, isolate, get an engineer/electrician), and both land on the right likely diagnosis of hot earth leakage from an element. Conversation 2 serves the homeowner better by giving an honest ranked differential (fan/base/grill element, then wiring/terminals, then board), explicitly cautioning that the function in use doesn't prove which element, requiring insulation testing before any part is chosen, and offering two safe, no-panel observations (function selected, smell/scorching) that match the expected sensible first step. Conversation 1 is correct but thin, slightly overstates fire risk, and asks nothing about RCD vs MCB, burning smell, or model, leaving the homeowner with less to tell the engineer.
